native_arithmetic: Phase31 compares signedBYTE<=5 before increment/one-step. Attacktick62 incrementsBYTE with wrap then compares unsigned>=24.
Defense first caps signed upper20, receives native formation bonuses, then clamps signed0..20. Attack/defense additions wrap in32bits.
Damage uses low32bit product (20-defense)*attack followed by signed truncating division20, then signed-negative clamp0. Victim damage accumulation wrapsBYTE before signedDWORD threshold comparison.
Experience increment preserves signedWORD source, adds1 in32bits, caps only at100, then storesWORD. No lower clamp.
The attacker formation is cached before the first subpixel call; target and target formation cache at attack processing. Mutating global current actor never rebinds this function.
